scenes.text: Skeptics disagree. Biologist Robert Smith said the description matched a sandhill crane, a tall bird with red patches around its eyes.

scenes.text: John Keel's 1975 book, The Mothman Prophecies, and a 2002 film kept the legend alive.

scenes.text: Today, a 12-foot steel statue stands in town, and every September the festival returns. Whatever they saw, Point Pleasant has never forgotten.
